lessons.trigger_condition: A second frame-level review of the uploaded 2026-10-03 tablet reference recording showed fast game tabs, region selection and HOT discovery. The V407 tablet home already ranked verified market modules, but market_activity counted sale rows without dataset-age weighting and lifecycle=current event rows without excluding expired or tracking-only placeholders, so stale evidence could retain too much UI influence.
lessons.prevention_rule: Weight market, release and promo activity by each dataset updated_at freshness; exclude ended and tracking-only event placeholders from current-event attention; derive only bounded Pokémon/ONE PIECE/NARUTO and KR/JP/US focus from verified attention rows; default to ALL when the leading score is not materially separated; expose reversible session-only filter chips; never infer price direction, persist click behavior, invent stock/grade facts or expand runtime execution authority.
validation_required: market_watch, releases and promo_events activity is multiplied by bounded dataset freshness
expired lifecycle=current rows and tracking_only placeholders do not count as active events
market lens game allowlist is exactly Pokémon, ONE PIECE and NARUTO
market lens region allowlist is exactly KR, JP and US
ambiguous focus fails closed to ALL and no price direction is used
tablet market-lens controls are reversible and session-only and are not training signals
existing 18-feature screen neural, Champion/Challenger, rollback and source-code safety gates remain unchanged
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V408 changes verified attention weighting and presentation only. It does not invent market direction, prices, grades, stock, releases or events; does not persist precise location or user behavior; and does not generate/rewrite source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main or bypass verification.
